title: Jensen Huang reportedly engaged a PR firm with a history of handling high-profile sex scandals a year ago - TechCrunch
description: The PR firm was enlisted shortly after an October 2025 New York Times report described Alice Huang's business dealings with Jensen Huang, Wired reported.

title: Democrat Eileen Laubacher declares victory over Rep. Lauren Boebert in Colorado’s 4th Congressional District - The Denver Post
description: Eileen Laubacher, a retired Navy rear admiral, continued to lead Monday with 48.8% of the vote to Lauren Boebert’s 47.9% — a margin of just under 1 percentage point.

title: HBO Max-Paramount+ Bundle Set To Launch In Early 2027, David Ellison Confirms - Deadline
